content.title: From Season 4 Premiere Date and First Look - IMDb
content.text: From Season 4 Premiere Date and First LookToday, MGM+ shared the first teaser for the highly anticipated fourth season of fan-favorite sci-fi horror series From. The new season will premiere Sunday, April 19, on MGM+.Created by John Griffin (Crater) and executive produced by Griffin, showrunner Jeff Pinkner, and director Jack Bender, the series unravels the mystery of a nightmarish town that traps all those who enter.From is the most-viewed series in premium network MGM+’s history and has a 96% Rotten Tomatoes score.In Season Four, the closer the residents of town get to the answers they seek, the more terrifying their search becomes. Who is the Man in Yellow, and what does he want?
